requirements.title: Core types and fingerprint algorithm
requirements.text: The tool shall implement the §4 Finding type and §4.2 fingerprint algorithm exactly as specified in the x-FuSa spec.

requirements.title: Python coding-standard lint rules
requirements.text: The tool shall check Python source files for function length, nesting depth, cyclomatic complexity, mutable defaults, star imports, and assert statements.

requirements.title: File length check
requirements.text: The tool shall warn when a Python source file exceeds the configured maximum line count.

requirements.title: Nesting depth check
requirements.text: The tool shall warn when a Python function exceeds the maximum allowed block nesting depth.

requirements.title: Cyclomatic complexity check
requirements.text: The tool shall warn when a Python function exceeds the maximum allowed cyclomatic complexity.

requirements.title: Mutable default argument check
requirements.text: The tool shall warn when a Python function has a mutable default argument (list, dict, or set).

requirements.title: Star import check
requirements.text: The tool shall warn on wildcard imports that obscure module dependencies.

requirements.title: Assert statement check
requirements.text: The tool shall warn when assert statements are used in place of explicit safety checks.

requirements.title: Bare except clause detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR for bare except clauses (CWE-703).

requirements.title: eval() usage detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR when eval() is used (CWE-95).

requirements.title: exec() usage detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR when exec() is used (CWE-78).

requirements.title: Pickle deserialization detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR when pickle.load/loads is used (CWE-502).

requirements.title: Thread synchronization check
requirements.text: The tool shall warn when threading.Thread is created without apparent synchronization.

requirements.title: CLI exit codes
requirements.text: The tool shall use exit codes 0 (success), 1 (gate failure), 2 (usage error), 3 (runtime error) per x-FuSa spec §2.3.

requirements.title: Version command
requirements.text: The tool shall implement the version command per x-FuSa spec §9.1.

requirements.title: Capabilities command
requirements.text: The tool shall implement the capabilities command per x-FuSa spec §9.1.

requirements.title: Check command
requirements.text: The tool shall implement the check command per x-FuSa spec §4.

requirements.title: Trace command
requirements.text: The tool shall implement the trace command per x-FuSa spec §5.

requirements.title: Qualify command
requirements.text: The tool shall implement the qualify command per x-FuSa spec §6.

requirements.title: Release command
requirements.text: The tool shall implement the release command per x-FuSa spec §7.

requirements.title: Audit-pack command
requirements.text: The tool shall implement the audit-pack command per x-FuSa spec §8.

requirements.title: No external dependencies
requirements.text: The tool shall have no external runtime dependencies beyond the Python standard library.

requirements.title: HLR/LLR decomposition validation
requirements.text: The trace command shall validate that every LLR references a valid HLR via parent_id, every HLR has at least one LLR child, and gate on violations per the active integrity level.

requirements.title: Orphan LLR detection
requirements.text: The trace validator shall emit an orphan-llr violation for any LLR that lacks a parent_id or references a non-existent HLR.

requirements.title: Empty HLR detection
requirements.text: The trace validator shall emit an empty-hlr violation for any HLR that has no LLR children.

requirements.title: HLR/LLR severity gating
requirements.text: Violations shall be WARNING for DAL-C/ASIL-C and below; ERROR for DAL-A/ASIL-D or when --strict-hlr-llr is set.

requirements.title: Tool qualification display
requirements.text: The qualify command shall show a qualification badge (independently-qualified / self-qualified / unqualified) and accept --qualification-method, --qualifier, and --record-uri flags.

requirements.title: Qualification badge derivation
requirements.text: The badge shall be independently-qualified when qualification_method=independent or qualifier_identity is non-empty; self-qualified when method=self; unqualified otherwise.

requirements.title: Qualification record URI in JSON output
requirements.text: When --record-uri is provided, the qualify JSON output shall include qualificationRecordUri.

requirements.title: qualify --output always writes JSON
requirements.text: When --output <file> is given, the qualify command shall write the JSON qualification record to that file regardless of the --format flag's value, since the x-FuSa spec documents only a JSON schema for the qualify artifact.

requirements.title: V&V independence reporting
requirements.text: The qualify command shall accept --implementation-author, --independent-reviewer, --independent-test-executor flags and emit an independenceStatus field.

requirements.title: Independence status derivation
requirements.text: Status shall be independent when reviewer != author; same-author when equal; unknown when either is absent.

requirements.title: Achievable ASIL field
requirements.text: When --achievable-asil is provided, the qualify JSON output shall include achievableAsil.

requirements.title: MC/DC coverage analysis
requirements.text: The coverage command shall accept --mcdc, --mcdc-file, and --mcdc-threshold flags and parse LLVM coverage JSON to produce a structured MC/DC report with hard gate on uncovered conditions.

requirements.title: LLVM MC/DC JSON parsing
requirements.text: A condition is MC/DC covered iff covered_true_count > 0 AND covered_false_count > 0.

requirements.title: MC/DC hard gate
requirements.text: If any annotated function has uncovered conditions, the overall coverage report shall fail (passed=false).

requirements.title: Weak cryptographic hash detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR when a weak cryptographic hash function (MD5/SHA-1) is used.

requirements.title: Weak symmetric cipher detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR when a weak symmetric cipher (DES/RC4/Triple-DES/Blowfish) is imported.

requirements.title: Insecure random source detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR when the random module is used to generate security-sensitive values (tokens, secrets, keys, nonces).

requirements.title: Unsafe memory access detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING when ctypes/cffi is used for unsafe memory access.

requirements.title: Command injection detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR when subprocess is called with a non-literal command or shell=True.

requirements.title: Hardcoded credential detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR when a credential-named variable is assigned a hardcoded string literal.

requirements.title: TLS certificate verification disabled detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR when TLS certificate verification is disabled (verify=False or ssl.CERT_NONE).

requirements.title: HTTP server without timeout detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING when an HTTP server is created without a request timeout.

requirements.title: Integer narrowing detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING on explicit integer narrowing conversions with non-constant values.

requirements.title: SQL/path string concatenation detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR when a SQL or path API call is built via string concatenation.

requirements.title: SSRF detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING when an HTTP client call uses a non-literal URL.

requirements.title: Debug mode exposure detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR when a web framework is run with debug=True.

requirements.title: Zip slip detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR when an archive is extracted via extractall() without member validation.

requirements.title: Weak TLS version detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR when a deprecated/weak TLS protocol version is configured.

requirements.title: SQL injection via format string detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR when a SQL query is built using an f-string or %-format containing SQL keywords.

requirements.title: Permissive directory mode detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING when a directory is created with mode=0o777.

requirements.title: Permissive file mode detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING when a file is created with mode 0o666 or 0o777.

requirements.title: Path traversal from user input detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR when a file path API is called with a variable derived from user-controlled input.

requirements.title: TOCTOU race condition detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING when a file's existence is checked and then opened, exposing a TOCTOU race window.

requirements.title: Insecure temporary file detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR when tempfile.mktemp() is used to create a temporary file.

requirements.title: SBOM presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall warn when a project has no sbom.json Software Bill of Materials.

requirements.title: Build provenance presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall warn when a project has no provenance.json build provenance record.

requirements.title: Tool qualification evidence presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report when qualify-report.json tool qualification evidence is absent.

requirements.title: FMEA presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report when fmea.json dFMEA analysis evidence is absent.

requirements.title: TARA presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report when tara.json cybersecurity risk assessment evidence is absent.

requirements.title: Boundary diagram presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report when no system boundary diagram (boundary.json/.mermaid/.dot) is present.

requirements.title: Safety case presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report when no safety-case.json has been assembled.

requirements.title: Audit pack presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report when no audit-pack.zip evidence bundle is present.

requirements.title: Test evidence bundle presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report when no .fusa-evidence.json test evidence bundle is present.

requirements.title: Test evidence zero-failure check
requirements.text: The tool shall warn when the test evidence bundle reports one or more failed or errored tests.

requirements.title: HARA presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall warn (for iso26262/iec61508 projects) when no .fusa-hara.json hazard analysis is present.

requirements.title: Hazard risk-rating completeness check
requirements.text: The tool shall warn when a hazard's risk rating (severity, exposure, controllability) is incomplete.

requirements.title: Hazard-to-safety-goal linkage check
requirements.text: The tool shall warn when a hazard has no linked safety goal, or references an unknown one.

requirements.title: Safety goal ASIL assignment check
requirements.text: The tool shall warn when a safety goal has no ASIL assigned.

requirements.title: Safety goal ASIL ceiling check
requirements.text: The tool shall warn when a safety goal's ASIL exceeds the project's configured ASIL ceiling.

requirements.title: Disposition completeness check
requirements.text: The tool shall warn when an ERROR finding in check-report.json has no corresponding disposition entry.

requirements.title: Additional CLI subcommands
requirements.text: The tool shall provide additional CLI subcommands (init, report, lint, analyze, cyber, fmea, boundary, coupling, tara, hara, diff, badge, req, fix, hooks, sign, vuln, pr, disposition, impact, metrics, safety-case, unece, sas, sci, coverage, template, comp, misra, verify) each running its associated analysis or report generation and exiting with the standard exit codes.

requirements.title: Change impact analysis
requirements.text: The tool shall map git-changed files to impacted requirements and stale evidence artefacts.

requirements.title: dFMEA generation
requirements.text: The tool shall scan Python source for raise/thread/return/req-id signals and generate a dFMEA table (fmea.json / CSV).

requirements.title: Rule registry and execution engine
requirements.text: The tool shall register all rule implementations, execute them against a project, apply dispositions, and aggregate findings into a run result.

requirements.title: Coupling analysis report generation
requirements.text: The tool shall run coupling-specific rules and generate a coupling-report.json summarising data/control coupling findings.

requirements.title: Software Configuration Index generation
requirements.text: The tool shall generate a Software Configuration Index enumerating the presence of source, requirements, hazard analysis, and other evidence artefacts per DO-178C §11.16.

requirements.title: Thread/task without stop-event detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING when a thread or async task is created without an apparent stop/done event signal in scope (ANA001).

requirements.title: Unbounded thread/task spawn in loop detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING when a thread or async task is created inside a loop without a concurrency bound (ANA002).

requirements.title: Uninterruptible sleep in thread worker detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING when time.sleep() is called inside a thread worker target, since it cannot be interrupted (ANA003).

requirements.title: Exception raised inside finally block detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING when a finally block may raise, swallowing the original exception (ANA004).

requirements.title: Redundant global/config lookup detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING when a function re-fetches a value from global/config state that it already receives as a parameter (ANA005).

requirements.title: Discarded call return value detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING when the return value of a call that must be checked (e.g. subprocess.run, os.rename) is discarded (ANA006).

requirements.title: Potential None dereference detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING when an attribute is accessed on a value that may be None because it came from a lookup call such as .get()/.find() (ANA007).

requirements.title: Shared mutable state modified in thread context detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING when a thread target mutates shared mutable state via 'global' without synchronisation (ANA008).

requirements.title: Unreachable code (dead code) detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING for statements that are unreachable after a return/raise/break/continue (ANA009).

requirements.title: SLSA L1 vcsRevision provenance rule
requirements.text: The tool shall report an INFO finding when provenance.json is missing a vcsRevision field, as required by SLSA L1 (SLSA001).

requirements.title: SLSA L2 builder identification rule
requirements.text: The tool shall report an INFO finding when provenance.json is missing a builder field, as required by SLSA L2 (SLSA002).

requirements.title: SLSA L3 two-party review policy rule
requirements.text: The tool shall report an INFO finding when no CODEOWNERS file or branch-protection policy is found, as required by SLSA L3 (SLSA003).

requirements.title: Cyclomatic complexity threshold engine rule
requirements.text: The engine shall report a WARNING when a public function's cyclomatic complexity V(G) exceeds the project's ASIL/DAL threshold (COMP001, DO-178C §6.3.4).

requirements.title: Module-level mutable variable coupling rule
requirements.text: The engine shall report an INFO finding for a public module-level mutable variable, which creates data coupling (COUP001).

requirements.title: Callable-parameter control-coupling rule
requirements.text: The engine shall report an INFO finding when a public function accepts a Callable parameter, which creates control coupling (COUP002).

requirements.title: Coupling report presence rule
requirements.text: The engine shall report a WARNING when coupling-report.json is not present in the project (COUP003).

requirements.title: IEC 62443 Security Level declaration rule
requirements.text: The engine shall report an INFO finding when .fusa-iec62443.json declaring the IEC 62443 Security Level is not present (IEC62443-001).

requirements.title: IEC 62443 target_sl range validation rule
requirements.text: The engine shall report a WARNING when the declared target_sl is not an integer in the range 1-4 (IEC62443-002).

requirements.title: IEC 62443 security policy document rule
requirements.text: The engine shall report an INFO finding when no security policy document (e.g. SECURITY.md) is found, as required by IEC 62443-4-2 CR 6.2 (IEC62443-003).

requirements.title: IEC 62443 incident response plan rule
requirements.text: The engine shall report an INFO finding when no cyber incident response plan is found, as required by IEC 62443-4-2 CR 6.2.1 (IEC62443-004).

requirements.title: Project configuration loading and validation
requirements.text: The tool shall load and validate .fusa.json (including legacy flat project-name form), derive an integrity label from ASIL/SIL/DAL, and load the dispositions and requirements sidecar files.

requirements.title: Standard-specific compliance gap report generation
requirements.text: The tool shall generate a standard-specific compliance gap report (ISO 26262, IEC 61508, DO-178C, ISO 21434, UNECE R.155, SLSA, IEC 62443) summarising which evidence artefacts are present or missing for the requested compliance level.

requirements.title: Content-quality baseline: placeholder-text detection (rule A)
requirements.text: The tool shall scan the qualitative fields of fmea/hara/tara/safety-case/sas evidence for bracket-wrapped instructional text or a deny-listed placeholder substring and flag a match as an always-ERROR FUSA-STUB001 finding, per x-FuSa spec section 1.6.1 rule A.

requirements.title: Content-quality baseline: blanket-fallback detection (rule B)
requirements.text: The tool shall compute each qualitative field's distinct-value ratio across an artifact's entries and flag a ratio below 0.1 across at least 10 entries as a WARNING FUSA-STUB002 finding, per x-FuSa spec section 1.6.1 rule B.

requirements.title: Content-quality baseline: disposition matching
requirements.text: The tool shall match FUSA-STUB001/FUSA-STUB002 findings against .fusa-dispositions.json using the same fingerprint/ruleId/file/line matching rules as the check engine, so FUSA-STUB001 remains disposition-suppressible outside of check.

requirements.title: Content-quality baseline: combined gate
requirements.text: The tool shall suppress an open FUSA-STUB002 finding when a non-stale, independent attestation is present, and shall otherwise gate on it only when --require-attestation or --strict is given; FUSA-STUB001 shall always participate in the gate unless individually disposition-accepted or deferred.

requirements.title: Per-artifact content-quality scan
requirements.text: The fmea, tara, hara, safety-case, and sas commands shall each run the x-FuSa spec section 1.6.1 rule A/B scan over their own just-generated document's qualitative fields.

requirements.title: CLI content-quality gate integration
requirements.text: The fmea, hara, tara, safety-case, and sas CLI commands shall support --strict and --require-attestation flags and shall exit 1 when the combined content-quality gate fails.

requirements.title: FUSA-STUB001 check-engine rule
requirements.text: The check engine shall scan every committed fmea.json/tara.json/.fusa-hara.json/safety-case.json/sas.json for placeholder text and surface FUSA-STUB001 findings alongside the tool's other check findings.

requirements.title: FUSA-STUB002 check-engine rule
requirements.text: The check engine shall scan every committed fmea.json/tara.json/.fusa-hara.json/safety-case.json/sas.json for a blanket qualitative fallback and surface an unsuppressed FUSA-STUB002 finding alongside the tool's other check findings.

requirements.title: Attestation content hash
requirements.text: The tool shall compute a canonical sha256: content hash over an evidence document's substantive content, excluding its header/attestation/generatedAt fields, per x-FuSa spec section 1.6.2.

requirements.title: Attestation validity
requirements.text: The tool shall treat an attestation as valid only when status is reviewed, independentReviewer is non-empty and differs from implementationAuthor, and contentHash matches the document's current content hash; any other case shall be treated as heuristic (fail-safe).

requirements.title: Attestation passthrough
requirements.text: The fmea, tara, and safety-case commands shall load the attestation object from a previously-generated evidence file of the same name, if present, and carry it into the newly-generated document verbatim.

requirements.title: FMEA coverage metrics and heuristic differentiation
requirements.text: The fmea command shall report summary.componentsAnalyzed, summary.componentsInProject (the same denominator as trace --func-coverage), and summary.coveragePct, and shall support --min-coverage N; failureMode/effect/cause shall be derived from each function's actual signature/behaviour rather than one fixed string.

requirements.title: TARA SFOP impact and coverage metrics
requirements.text: The tara command shall rate each threat's impact across the four ISO 21434 Clause 15.7 SFOP axes (safety/financial/operational/privacy) rather than one generic severity, and shall report summary.assetsAnalyzed/assetsInProject/coveragePct/assetInventoryMethod, supporting --min-coverage N.

requirements.title: GSN safety-case schema conformance
requirements.text: The safety-case command shall emit nodes[] typed goal/strategy/solution/context/assumption/justification and edges[] typed supportedBy/inContextOf per the GSN Community Standard v3, with a completeness roll-up of undeveloped goals.

requirements.title: HARA section 1.2.5 validation
requirements.text: The hara command shall validate .fusa-hara.json referential integrity (hazards[].situations, hazards[].safetyGoals, safetyGoals[].fssrRefs against .fusa-reqs.json) and shall require every safety goal to carry at least one fssrRefs entry, surfacing violations as Findings.

requirements.title: HARA completeness roll-up and JSON report
requirements.text: The hara command's --format json output shall carry the common header, the .fusa-hara.json content verbatim, and a completeness block (totalHazards, hazardsWithAsil, hazardsWithSafetyGoal, safetyGoalsWithFssrRefs, danglingReferences).
